dog.description_text:
Zeus is a 7-month-old mixed breed who weighs around 22 pounds and this sweet boy is full of puppy energy, affection, and curiosity. He has an adorable little face that might remind you of a Pug or Boxer, but he's a one of a kind!

Zeus is a happy, friendly pup who loves to play, socialize, and soak up attention from the people around him. He's also very dog-friendly and enjoys having other pups to play with. When it comes to people, he's just as sweet! He's happy to meet new faces and enjoy a good pet.

Like any young pup, Zeus is still working on his house-training, leash skills, and crate training, so he'll need a patient adopter ready to help him learn and grow. He's a loving little guy, and we can't wait for him to find a family to call his own!

Registered adopters interested in Zeus can email adopt@hbrdogs.com for more info. If you're not registered yet, do it today at hbrdogs.com!
